dsm_policy: 45m/8m is evaluated only for mechanically classified high-elevation bare/snow. Low-elevation tree/vegetated/built surfaces and unknown/mixed are inconclusive and fail closed to manual review.
low_forest_false_rejection_note: No low-forest case has independent summit truth in this pilot, so its false-rejection rate denominator is zero; report inconclusive count, never infer an accuracy rate.
world_peak_disclaimer: 样本为 7 座世界级高峰，不代表目录整体，尤其不代表低海拔小山。
